channel.title: Market notes — The Marginal Token
channel.description: Changes that affect the cost of buying and running AI.

item.title: Flint: local coding, hardware requirements and running costs
item.description: Recursive’s coding model has downloadable Apache-2.0 weights. Its optimized Mac runtime requires specific chips and at least 48 GB of memory; running costs depend on hardware use and task success.

item.title: Clairic: extraction at $0.10 per million input tokens
item.description: Cloudflare’s extraction preview charges for input only. The practical test is cost per accepted extraction, including validation and human review.

item.title: Mercury 3: launch prices and the Mercury 2 migration deadline
item.description: Mercury 3 launches at half its regular token rates. Existing direct customers of Mercury 2 and 2.5 have until 15 November to migrate, with enterprise agreements treated separately.

item.title: AI model releases: 12–16 October 2026
item.description: Gemini 4 Argon and Muse Wonder expand the API choices. Muse Spark Open and NVIDIA’s Nemotron releases bring new deployment options. A review of the week so far, with access and costs checked.

item.title: Muse Spark Open: deployment hardware and license terms
item.description: Muse Spark Open’s weights are available under custom terms. Compare its deployment hardware and licensing conditions with hosted API prices.

item.title: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL and Bolt: model size and local deployment
item.description: NVIDIA’s Bolt compresses Super VL for local deployment. A smaller model footprint changes the hardware calculation; it does not settle the bill.

item.title: Step 5 Preview: weights, hardware and license terms
item.description: Step 5 Preview’s weights are public. Its active parameter count tells only part of the deployment story.

item.title: Gemini 4 Argon: API prices double on 1 December
item.description: Gemini 4 Argon’s posted token prices double on 1 December. Budget recurring work using both the introductory and scheduled rates.

item.title: Muse Wonder: API pricing and Wonder Full access
item.description: Muse Wonder’s API rates match Opus 5.5. Wonder Full is available through specific Muse Code subscriptions.

item.title: Haiku 5.5: higher API rates above 100,000 prompt tokens
item.description: The 100,000-token boundary changes both input and output rates. Price agent workloads by prompt length, with cached tokens included.
